title: A look at Angular, Vue and Svelte, from where React stands

videos.script:
Lesson one placed React among the other options in words. This last lesson does it in code: one small component, written four times.

{{react}} First in React, as this course has written everything. A week of three sessions, a sentence that adds up the minutes, and a line in the console every time the component's code runs. Two clicks, and it runs three times.

{{vue}} Then in Vue, with a template and a ref. The same page, and the code runs once.

{{svelte}} Then in Svelte, a compiler that writes the updates for you. Once again.

{{angular}} Then in Angular, a class and signals, from the framework that comes with everything. Once.

{{runs}} Then why: React runs your component again and compares, and the other three know which values the page read.

{{box}} And last, what each one weighs, what each one brings with it, and what all four have in common.
